findings.note: Senate news release from his office on his priority bills for the 88th session. It describes his SB 92 (online voter registration), which it says would replace paper forms that it calls slow, outdated and fraud-vulnerable. The release does not mention ID or citizenship proof.
He is the listed author of SB 92, relating to electronic voter registration. The page's last action is referral to the State Affairs committee on 2023-02-15.
